resolvedPrompt: Create an original 2D mobile arcade cartoon style anchor board for the fishing mini-game Harbor Pop. Apply the entire locked style profile fishing-v1 revision 1 without deviation. Show the primary angler, harbor, fishing rod, landing net, seven distinct fish silhouettes, and water splash effects in one coherent reference board with label-free visual zones and side-view gameplay references. Use polished contemporary 2026 mobile-game animation texture, crisp high-resolution three-tone cel shading, never pixel art or retro 8-bit. Preserve deep-blue #14364A rounded outlines; sea teal #2BA9A1, deep water #176B87, foam #EAF9F4, coral #F47B61, sand #E9C77C, rare violet #7656C9; upper-left warm daylight. Use side-view entities and 3/4-side props. Preserve the coral cap, teal vest, rounded face, sand boots, head-to-body about 1:5, slightly oversized hands, chunky fish bodies, simple non-realistic eyes, layered motion-ready clothing, props, fish body and tail pivots, four-to-six-key cast and four-frame splash concepts. Keep silhouette, outline weight, palette, lighting, proportions, projection, and material language consistent. No thin fishing line baked into character art, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, copyrighted characters, artist imitation, photorealism, realistic fish scales or eyes, horror sea creatures, monster-style violet magic, or external asset collage.
